oracle-l5r-10262.note: Revelations (Event, issue #738): "Show the top five cards of your Dynasty deck. Choose another player who may discard one of the cards. Put the rest back in any order. Refill this province face-up." The scan prints no "After you reveal" clause, so it is an ordinary Event that resolves when revealed, but its three steps are not covered by what is merged: P20's "other player chooses" belongs to a deck search (a set of picked cards), not to a look at the top of a deck; the look (DeckLook.cs) lets its own player rearrange but has no step in which another player discards one of the shown cards before the rest go back; and the Event's own province must then refill face up from the reordered deck. It needs a look disposition with an other-player discard and a reorder, which is decision-UI work for batch 8 (#739), not a card-level guess.

oracle-l5r-8242.note: The Onyx Championship (Event, issue #738): "Choose one of your Shugenja in play. Permanently give him Shadowlands and the ability, 'Maho Limited: Bow this Shugenja and destroy your target Personality: Search your discard pile, then deck, then provinces for an Oni Personality. Bring him into play, paying all costs. Lose 3 Honor.'" The permanent keyword and ability grant are built (GrantKeyword, GrantAbility Permanent), and the ordered search of a discard pile, a deck and the provinces is P20's, but P20 lets a card found in a province enter play only ignoring its costs (SearchEffect.RecruitFromProvinceIgnoringCosts is the sole province recruit and ValidateSearchSpec refuses any other disposition for a province source), while the card prints "paying all costs" for every source. The pay-all-costs recruit from a province is not built; publishing the card with the ignoring-costs recruit would change a printed cost.
